title: Adidas Men (S) Spain Home (Small) Victory Jersey
writeup: Woot has the adidas Spain 2020-21 home replica jersey (style FR8361, Victory Red, AEROREADY fabric) new for $18.99 in men's size Small. New-with-tags copies of the same FR8361 jersey are going for $60.49 from a US eBay seller and $82.79 at Classic Football Shirts, so this is about 68% below the cheapest store. Only one was left when we checked.
